audit_standard: Master Engineering Brief Section 10 & 12 — Independent Acceptance Test
verdict_rationale: GameForge-27B is an authentically trained, standalone 16.81 GB Q4_K_M model registered in Ollama and runnable autonomously with verified 37-layer GPU offload on AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT. Physical tensor difference audits confirm non-zero learned parameter deltas on key attention/output normalization layers without corrupting vision projection tensors. However, technical limitations exist regarding the loss function metric (latent feature MSE rather than causal token cross-entropy) and the materialization technique (targeting FP32 normalization layers rather than full dequantization of all 866 tensors due to 32GB RAM headroom).
